target.title: [AI-assisted] feat(android): add chat command controls
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Android chat users need a visible New Chat control and a slash-command picker without Android becoming a second command-policy source.

The original PR shape had two review-blocking problems:

- Android could advertise hard-coded fallback slash commands when Gateway command discovery was empty or failed.
- The local `/new` / `/reset` and header new-chat path used admin-scoped `sessions.reset`, which does not match normal bounded Android operator sessions.

## Why This Change Was Made

This keeps the Android UI controls while moving command/session behavior back to the Gateway-owned contract:

- Gateway `commands.list` is the only source for slash-command suggestions.
- Empty or failed command discovery leaves Android with no local fallback catalog.
- Slash selection fills command text in the composer instead of intercepting `/new` or `/reset` locally.
- Header New Chat now uses `sessions.create` with the current parent session key, adopts the returned session key, and then refreshes session/history state.
- Native i18n inventory was resynced after the Android source changes.

This PR does not change Gateway descriptors, provider/model routing, permissions grants, dependencies, workflows, or lockfiles.

## User Impact

Android users still get first-class chat controls:

- The chat header exposes a New Chat action.
- The composer exposes slash-command suggestions from Gateway metadata.
- `/`, `/mo`, and alias prefixes such as `/de` continue to filter by command name or alias.
- Description/category text does not create unrelated slash matches.
- Android no longer shows commands the connected Gateway did not advertise.
- Exact `/new` or `/reset` text is no longer swallowed by a local Android reset handler.

Remaining limitation: connected Android visual proof is still not attached. The current evidence is source/test/CI proof, not screenshots or recording.

## Evidence

P1 contract fixes are included in head commit `40324bd5f0a1568c1c2d3815f414770098d3d133`.

Local proof after the P1 patch:

```text
git diff --check
PASS

pnpm native:i18n:check
native-app-i18n: entries=2360 changed=false
PASS

cd apps/android
./gradlew --no-daemon :app:testPlayDebugUnitTest :app:testThirdPartyDebugUnitTest --tests ai.openclaw.app.chat.ChatControllerCommandControlsTest --tests ai.openclaw.app.ui.chat.ChatCommandControlsTest
BUILD SUCCESSFUL in 50s
60 actionable tasks: 60 up-to-date

grep -R "defaultChatCommands\|isNewChatSlashCommand\|sessions.reset" -n apps/android/app/src/main/java apps/android/app/src/test/java || true
No matches.
```

GitHub Actions after the P1 push showed the focused Android and native inventory checks passing:

```text
native-i18n: SUCCESS
android-test-play: SUCCESS
android-test-third-party: SUCCESS
dependency-guard: SUCCESS
security-sensitive-guard: SUCCESS
```

